facts.statement: During SOE Super Fan Spring Fever, Free Realms was one of the participating games in a promotion where Station Cash purchases were doubled, running April 22-25.
facts.quote: Entre os dias 22 e 25 de abril, ganhe Station Cash dobrados quando você comprar SC!

article_summaries.title: SOE Super Fan Spring Fever - de 22 a 25 de abril
article_summaries.summary: This is a Portuguese-language SOE site-wide promotion post, not a Free Realms article. Free Realms appears only as one of several participating SOE games in a Station Cash double-purchase event held April 22-25; it gives no quests, items or mechanics. The year is not stated in the text; the capture date (2011-06-04) suggests 2011.
